n_1bc2bdb1420f58a7.name: Read the lead answers
n_1bc2bdb1420f58a7.source: export default function prepare({response,firstTitle,lastTitle,companyTitle,websiteTitle,baseId,table,channelId}){if(!response||!Array.isArray(response.definition?.fields)||!Array.isArray(response.answers))throw Error('Invalid Typeform response');for(const x of [firstTitle,lastTitle,companyTitle,websiteTitle,baseId,table,channelId])if(typeof x!=='string'||!x.trim()||x.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure question titles and destinations');const get=(title,required)=>{const f=response.definition.fields.filter(x=>x.title===title);if(f.length!==1)throw Error('Question title must be unique: '+title);const a=response.answers.filter(x=>x.field?.id===f[0].id);if(a.length>1)throw Error('Duplicate answer');let v=a[0]?.text??a[0]?.url??'';if(typeof v!=='string'||(required&&!v.trim()))throw Error('Missing answer: '+title);return v.trim()};const first_name=get(firstTitle,true),last_name=get(lastTitle,true),company=get(companyTitle,false),website=get(websiteTitle,false);if(!company&&!website)throw Error('Company or website is required');return{data:[{first_name,last_name,...(company?{company}:{}),...(website?{website}:{})}],baseId,table,channelId}}

n_42307d28391a3dec.name: Confirm enrichment request

n_55b57caa0204569d.name: Prepare contact fields
n_55b57caa0204569d.source: export default function enrich({data,error,success,status}){if(error||success!==true||status!=='succeeded'||!Array.isArray(data)||data.length!==1)throw Error('Enrichment is incomplete');const x=data[0];if(typeof x?.full_name!=='string'||!x.full_name.trim())throw Error('Enriched full name is missing');const fields={},put=(name,value)=>{if(typeof value==='string'&&value.trim())fields[name]=value.trim()};put('firstName',x.first_name);put('lastName',x.last_name);put('linkedInProfile',x.linkedin);put('Email',x.email?.[0]?.email);put('Phone',x.phone);put('website',x.website);put('LinkedIn Company',x.company_linkedin);put('Industry',x.naf5_des);put('Address',[x.siret_address,[x.siret_zip,x.siret_city].filter(Boolean).join(' ')].filter(Boolean).join(', '));if(!fields.firstName||!fields.lastName||!fields.Email)throw Error('Enriched name or email is missing');const name=x.full_name.trim(),escaped=name.replace(/\\/g,'\\\\').replace(/'/g,"\\'");return{fields,formula:"{fullName}='"+escaped+"'"}}

n_47861e3af740a58a.name: Choose create or update
n_47861e3af740a58a.source: export default function plan({records,offset,fields}){if(!Array.isArray(records)||records.length>1||offset)throw Error('Ambiguous Airtable contact match');if(!fields||typeof fields!=='object')throw Error('Missing fields');const id=records[0]?.id;if(records.length&&(!id||typeof id!=='string'))throw Error('Invalid contact record');return{create:!records.length,createRecords:[{fields}],updateRecords:[{id:id??'unused',fields}],expectedId:id??'',text:records.length?'🥳 An existing lead has just subscribed!':'🎉 A new lead has just subscribed!'}}

n_c45e9ff1b1e63ac8.name: Confirm new contact
n_c45e9ff1b1e63ac8.source: export default function confirm({records,expectedId,text,channelId}){if(!Array.isArray(records)||records.length!==1||typeof records[0]?.id!=='string'||!records[0].id||(expectedId&&records[0].id!==expectedId))throw Error('Airtable write not confirmed; inspect before retry');return{text,channelId}}

n_939ebe8067c13e6c.name: Confirm updated contact
n_939ebe8067c13e6c.source: export default function confirm({records,expectedId,text,channelId}){if(!Array.isArray(records)||records.length!==1||typeof records[0]?.id!=='string'||!records[0].id||(expectedId&&records[0].id!==expectedId))throw Error('Airtable write not confirmed; inspect before retry');return{text,channelId}}
